notes.title: New Gameplay Mode "Go" Available
notes.content:
[h1]It's time to GO!
[/h1] 
[h2]In GO Mode, it's all about Speed.[/h2]
[h3]Race the clock to defeat the hordes of the Simulation and uncover the secrets within as Cross gears up in his Eternal Armor Set to escape the realm of Beor once and for all.[/h3]

[b]As time progresses, the enemy’s strength grows:[/b]
Every minute, the enemy gains 1 level. Work quickly to clear the Area Objective while collecting as many Level Ups as you can. If the enemy gets too powerful, it’s all over.

[b]The Eternal Armor is all you need:[/b]
In GO Mode, Cross is equipped with his Eternal Armor. Each extra piece of Gear obtained increases the strength of his Sword, Shield, and Helmet, giving him the edge needed to defeat the growing threat.

[b]All necessary upgrades are already available to you:[/b]
Items like the Falconite Revolver, Hood of Phase Warping, and Cloak of Void Walking are already unlocked in GO Mode, allowing you to traverse any obstacle.

[b]The Puppeteer awaits:[/b]
Evelyn is already awake. It’s up to you to destroy the Simulation and uncover the schemes of the Puppeteer.

notes.title: PATCH Ver. 200015
notes.content:
This patch fixes the Soft-Lock that could potentially happen to players if they completed the "Legends of the Fallen" Quest Objectives before obtaining the Quest itself.

* Note: If you are a player who was experiencing this issue, once the Game loads, open your Quest screen and deselect "Legends of the Fallen," then select it again. Your Quest Objective count will update to match what you've actually completed.

notes.title: Eternal Edge + Update Version 110033
notes.content:
[h1]Version 110033 Quick Look![/h1]

[h2]// Major Fixes/Updates[/h2]
- Issue regarding Loading games from versions below 110010 has been fixed
- Locking on to enemies with the Falconite Revolver is now possible
- Fire Bombs have been added back into the game
- Cross's Bombs now display a countdown and animate while active

[h2]// General Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed an item icon bug on Vault Keys
- Fixed hit collider issue on Large enemies
- Fixed lock-on issues for various rare enemy types
- Fixed camera zoom issue when triggering a cutscene while aiming with the Falconite Revolver
- Fixed Event located in the Southern Sands, which was spawning below the ground
- The Quest Log now has a scroll bar when you've received too many quests to fit on the static panel
- Vehicle physics are now disabled when exiting the vehicle
- New item discovery popup text display issues have been resolved
- Fixed issue with missing tresure chest near Sanctuary
- Fixed floating treasure chests located in "the Fissure"
- Fixed issue that would cause the cursor to lock to the center of the screen when opening the Inventory while aiming with the Falconite Revolver
- Fixed various ambience issues
- Ally Healthbars have been adjusted in important scenarios (they now display on-screen under the player's health bar)
- Events now have proper time displays
- Cross will now be reduced to 1 LIFE if above a certain threshold when getting hit by one of his own bomb explosions
- Fixed water detection issues in Misty Caverns

* Other various bug fixes included not listed here

* Note that loading a save file from versions below 110010 may spawn the character in odd locations. After saving in the new version, this issue should be resolved.

* Saves are not always backwards compatible with previous versions.

notes.title: Eternal Edge Plus Update V 110014
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We're excited to release an update that has a ton of improvements to the game!

[h1]A Quick Look[/h1]

[h2]// Game Core Updates[/h2]
- Player Movement and Animation
	- Cross's Character movement and animation has been completely revamped.
	- Proper animation blending is now in use
	- Movement is now Physics driven
	- New Physics Interactions available, such as lifting Keys and bringing them to specific locations, and throwing objects
	- Legacy Ability System has been removed (combat, etc.)
	- Sprinting is now possible
	- Implemented Ledge Grab Points
	- Press "Confirm" at any time to sheathe your weapon if it is out (Default 'C' on Keyboard, 'A' on XBOX Controllers, 'X' on Playstation Controllers)

- Combat
	- Player now has free movement while in combat
	- While running, you can swing your sword to quickly destroy objects in your path
	- Lock on now gives you full movement freedom, allowing you to strafe around your enemies as desired
	- Sprinting and Dodging will reduce your stamina meter, which will recharge over time. This helps balance Shield/Dodging gameplay

- Revolver System
	- Targeting has been re-programmed
	- On Mouse and Keyboard, (default) press 'R' to pull out the Revolver or Cancel, and Left Click to fire
	- On Controllers, (default) press Right Trigger to pull out the Revolver, and continue to press to fire. Press the Sword Attack button to Cancel (default 'X' for XBOX, and 'Square' for Playstation)
	- Individual Ammo types have been updated to be more effective

- Bomb Tool System
	- Bomb system has been updated to use the new Physics Interaction system
	- Only one Bomb can be active at a time
	- Press the assigned tool button to activate a Bomb, and press again or press 'Confirm' to Place or Throw
	- When aiming with the Revolver, you can Hold the Left Trigger (Right Click on Mouse/Keyboard) to lock on to an active bomb
	- Bombs can now be detonated with the Revolver

- Tool Quickswap
	- Mouse/Keyboard: Hold 'R' to activate the Revolver Ammo Quickswap Menu, 'E' for Bombs, and '1' for Utilities. Use the Mouse to make a selection
	- Controllers: Tools are now assigned a Quickswap menu on the Controller's Directional Pad. Hold down the assigned Directional Button to bring up the Quickswap Menu for that tool, and use the Right Stick to make a selection

- World Flow
	- Tools are now unlocked in a more Linear fashion, making exploring the world less confusing
	- New Revolver Doors and Bomb obstacles can now be found in the world

[h2]// Location Updates in this Version[/h2]
- Fields of Ruin
- Expanse
- Great Plains
- Misty Caverns [Dungeon 1]
- The Undercity [Dungeon 3]

[h3]// Location Updates still to come:[/h3]
- Southern Sands
- Woeful Woods
- Black Crow Keep [Dungeon 2]
- Aeveternal Tree [Dungeon 4]
- Grounds of the Citadel [Dungeon 5]

* CORE Mode is available by default, allowing you to experience Eternal Edge + in a traditional Adventure Game fashion.

* Various bug fixes included

* Note that loading a save file from versions below 110010 may spawn the character in odd locations. After saving in the new version, this issue should be resolved. All the mid-to-late game content still needs polishing. Please keep in mind that saves are not backward compatible.

We plan on doing more frequent updates similar to this one so be on the lookout for more updates! Caught a bug or want to share your feedback with us? Join the devs on [url=https://discord.gg/Tzu7GnS]Discord [/url]or in the Steam Discussions. 

Let us know what you'd like to see in the game ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Eternal Edge + Version 102023 (永恒之刃+ 版本102023)
notes.content:

* Players can now change key bindings from the Settings screen when loaded into the game. This is currently only functional for Mouse & Keyboard controls, not Controllers or Gamepads.

notes.title: Eternal Edge + Alpha Version 0.0.15.4 PATCH
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34606453/0bf1864725e756fa10f372f24e915db05c28d09d.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Release notes![/b][/h1]
[b]What’s New:[/b]
● The Jump attack can now push enemies back a few feet.
● Enemies that are blocking now get pushed back and flinch when hit.
● 2-Handed weapon attacks are now faster.
● The old Voxel Runic enemies have been replaced with updated Crab environmental enemies.
● The HUD has been further cleaned up, and an option to disable on-screen controls has been added in the Settings tab of the Inventory.

[b]What’s Been Fixed:[/b]
● Controller connect/disconnect has been fixed, allowing the game to update on-screen buttons properly as well as handle switching between controllers on the fly.
● The Lock-On Camera has been tweaked, allowing the player to take full control after the camera has panned to the locked enemy.
● A bug with Blocking has been fixed that had a random chance of injuring the player, regardless of the Shield being raised or not.
● The Player animation for dodge-rolling while locked on has been fixed.
● Keyboard input now buffers properly in shops.

notes.title: Eternal Edge +, Version 0.0.14 UPDATE!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Eternal Edge Plus, Version 0.0.14[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34606453/53d0b105d6c672014dc3c908e53919bbcb61db89.png[/img]

[b]What’s New:[/b]
● New “Machine Knight” and “Machine Warrior” behaviours add a tell to make them easier to dodge.

● Various Dungeons have been lengthened.

● “Power Levels” now give 75 EXP.
● Updated the first event (Retake Fort, Defend the Flag) to make it more manageable.

● A Wrong-Warping bug when exiting interiors has been fixed.
● The user can now hold down the analog stick in the inventory to move around.
● Fast Traveling has been fixed.
● An Audio bug that caused the intro music to loop too long has been fixed.
● Level Exp Bar bug has been fixed.
● Lock-On has been updated to better focus on an enemy.
● “Cackle Bats” can no longer push you around on the field (when fighting).
● Various bug fixes
